items.q: because Toby was my friend, too, because he was one of the first musicians I met when I first started playing

ctx.x: Well, he just -- he was gone. But Toby -- because Toby was my friend, too, because he was one of the first musicians I met when I first started playing, and he told me. So every time I'd see him, he'd sort of give me advice about the band, you know. He'd say, "Don't let them do this to you, because they'll do this to you.
